🎯 5-Tier 0s/1s/2s Matchup Thresholds (SW, W, N, L, SL)

• SW = Strong Win (rating >= 620) (Default: 620)
• W = Win (530 <= rating < 620) (Default: 530)
• N = Neutral / Grey (470 < rating < 530) (Default: 470–530)
• L = Loss (380 < rating <= 470) (Default: 470)
• SL = Strong Loss (rating <= 380) (Default: 380)

📖 SilphScope PvP — Complete Help, HUD & Tactics Guide (v3.01)
Everything you need to master the floating PvP overlay, 3x3 damage & shield matrix, 50s swap clocks, move pacing, Battle Log analytics, and Tasker automation.
1. General Battle Flow & How to Interact with the Overlay

• Step 1 — Select or Build Your Team: On the ⚔️ Teams tab, tap any team preset to make it active (or tap '+ New Team' to build a custom Great, Ultra, Master, or Mega Master League trio with auto-filled PvPoke recommended moves and IV/CP scaling).
• Step 2 — Launch the Overlay: Tap 'Start Battle Overlay' at the top of the app. Grant 'Display over other apps' and 'Screen Capture' (used strictly in-memory at 1 Hz for ML Kit OCR — zero screenshots are ever written to disk).
• Step 3 — Reposition or Minimize Anytime: Drag the overlay header to position it anywhere on screen. Between battles or while walking/catching, tap the '⚔️' icon in the top-left of the overlay to collapse it into a tiny floating bubble and pause OCR scanning.
• Step 4 — Switch Teams In-Overlay: Tap the team name dropdown ('▼') in the overlay header to switch active presets without leaving Pokémon GO.
• Step 5 — Start Battle ('⚔️ Start Battle'): When a GBL match begins, tap '⚔️ Start Battle' on the overlay. This clears the previous opponent lineup, resets both 50s swap clocks, resets shields (2v2) and Pokéballs (3v3), anchors the battle timeline clock (t=0s), and changes the button to '🛑 Stop Battle'.
• Step 6 — Stop & Log ('🛑 Stop Battle'): When the match ends, tap '🛑 Stop Battle'. OCR pauses and the quick-log bar appears: verify or tap the Lead Matchup chip ('Fav / Neu / Neg') and tap '🏆 Win' or '💀 Loss' (or '✕ Skip').
2. How to Read Battle Damage Numbers & Use the 3x3 Matrix

• 3x3 Grid Layout: The 3 columns represent the opponent's 3 Pokémon in the exact order revealed ([1st Lead, 2nd First Swap, 3rd Closer]). The 3 rows represent your 3 Pokémon.
• Charged Move Damage Percentages (C1% / C2%): Each cell displays the exact percentage of HP that each charged move deals in that head-to-head pairing, accounting for League CP stat scaling, dual-type effectiveness (up to 2.56x), STAB (1.2x), and Shadow modifiers (+20% ATK / -16.7% DEF).
• Tactical Tank vs. Shield Decisions: Use the damage numbers to know immediately whether an incoming charged move can be safely tanked (e.g. 38%) or requires a shield (e.g. 82%), and whether your own charged move is in KO range.
• Interactive Opponent Column Headers: Tap any opponent name in the top header row to set it as the active opponent, toggle Shadow ('S') status if OCR missed the purple aura, or cycle Regional/Alternate forms (e.g. Alolan, Galarian, Origin, Crowned).
• Interactive User Rows: Tap any of your 3 Pokémon rows on the left to manually mark your active on-field Pokémon and immediately update the live Move Pacing & Turn Alignment bar.

• 3 Shield Scenario Dots (0S • 1S • 2S): Every cell in the 3x3 matrix displays 3 indicator dots representing the 0-Shield, 1-Shield, and 2-Shield matchup ratings on PvPoke's 500-centered scale:
 - [+] Bright Emerald (SW — Strong Win, rating ≥ 620): Dominant wall / hard counter.
 - [●] Green (W — Win, 530 ≤ rating < 620): Favorable matchup.
 - [●] Slate Grey (N — Neutral, 470 < rating < 530): Even 50/50 matchup decided by energy lead, IVs, or baiting.
 - [●] Red (L — Loss, 380 < rating ≤ 470): Unfavorable matchup.
 - [×] Dark Crimson (SL — Strong Loss, rating ≤ 380): Hard-countered loss — swap or catch immediately.
• Reading Shield Flip Scenarios: Compare the 3 dots left-to-right (0S, 1S, 2S). For example, if a cell shows [Red, Green, Red], you lose the 0S and 2S but WIN the 1-Shield scenario — meaning you should commit exactly 1 shield to flip the matchup!
• Customizing Thresholds: You can customize the exact SW / W / L / SL rating cutoffs anytime in ⚙️ Settings → 5-Tier Matchup Rating Thresholds.
• Dynamic 9-State Asymmetric Shield Matrix (0v0 through 2v2): Under the hood, SilphScope evaluates all 9 discrete shield permutations (0v0, 0v1, 0v2, 1v0, 1v1, 1v2, 2v0, 2v1, 2v2) as shields are spent during the match.
4. 50s Swap Clocks, Shield/Faint Tracking & Top Statusbar Toasts

• Dual Independent 50s Swap Timers: Automatically starts a 50-second countdown whenever you or the opponent switches Pokémon:
 - Red (50s–16s): Switch locked on cooldown.
 - Orange/Amber (15s–1s): Switch window opening soon — prepare to throw energy or catch.
 - Green (0s Ready): Switch available immediately.
• Smart Faint Swap-In Clock Preservation: When a Pokémon faints and a replacement enters, SilphScope detects the Pokéball drop and preserves the existing swap timer instead of falsely resetting it to 50s.
• Automatic Pokéball (3→2→1) & Shield (2→1→0) Tracking: Samples the top HUD lobes to track remaining Pokémon and shields for both players. When an opponent Pokémon faints, its column in the 3x3 matrix automatically dims so you can focus on surviving threats.
• Top Statusbar / Clock Strip Battle Toasts: Real-time alerts for Swaps, Faint Swaps, and Shields Used appear in the top statusbar/clock area of the phone so they never block your charged move buttons (can be toggled in ⚙️ Settings).
5. Fast Move Counting, Cycle Pacing, Sneak Prevention & CMP

• Multi-Cycle Move Counts (Cycle 1 / 2 / 3): Shows exact fast moves required to reach Charged Move 1 and Charged Move 2 across 3 consecutive cycles, automatically accounting for leftover residual energy (e.g. 7 - 6 - 7).
• Count Basis ('My Fasts' vs. 'Their Fasts'): In ⚙️ Settings, choose whether opponent move counts are displayed in units of your own fast move taps ('My Fasts') or the opponent's fast move animations ('Their Fasts').
• Optimal Throw Timing (Sneak Prevention): In Pokémon GO, throwing a charged move on the exact turn an opponent's fast move finishes gives them a free 'sneak' turn. When fast move durations differ (e.g. 2-turn vs 3-turn), the HUD highlights exact attack numbers to throw on for zero-sneak alignment.
• CMP Tie Indicator ('CMP!'): Alerts you when your active Pokémon has higher Attack stat to win Charged Move Priority ties.
• 4 Charged Moves Mode: Enable in ⚙️ Settings to view up to 4 charged moves for unpredictable move-roulette opponents.
6. Battle Logs, Interactive Replay, WAE / Luck & GBL Exports

• 5-Stat Analytics Grid: Tracks Record (W-L), Lead Matchups (Fav/Neu/Neg), Win Rate %, EXEC WAE (Wins Above Expected micro-execution skill), and MATCHUP LUCK (Blind Matchup Favorability BMF). Tap the 'i' icon on EXEC WAE or MATCHUP LUCK anytime for the full mathematical breakdown and Badge Glossary.\n• Interactive Battle Recap & Replay: Tap any logged battle card in 📜 Battle Logs to open the full 3v3 Matchup Matrix & Timeline Replay for that battle.\n• Standardized Copy GBL & Share Summary: Use '📋 Copy GBL' for Go Battle Log format ([pokemon1 pokemon2 pokemon3] + opponent rows) or '📤 Share' for daily/season summaries with 'W/L (L->F/N/U, M->F/N/U) opponent1 opponent2 opponent3' rows and standardized Pokémon naming (e.g. ninetales_alolanS, laprasS, giratina_altered, charizard_MEGA_Y).
7. Multi-Device Cloud Sync, Trash Bin & Tasker Automation

• 2-Device GitHub Cloud Delta Sync: Sign in once per phone under ⚙️ Settings → Multi-Device Cloud Sync. Your Team Presets and Battle Logs automatically reconcile across devices on app open and after every logged battle.\n• Trash Bin & Instant Undo: Deleted teams or battles move to the 🗑️ Trash Bin with an instant '↩ UNDO' toast so nothing is ever lost by accident.\n• Tasker Automation Hooks: Control the overlay from Tasker without switching apps using com.gbl.overlay.ACTION_START_OVERLAY, com.gbl.overlay.ACTION_STOP_OVERLAY, or open straight to 📜 Battle Logs with com.gbl.overlay.ACTION_OPEN_BATTLE_LOG (1-tap copy buttons available in ⚙️ Settings).
